name: casting_flash
purpose: Casting flash and sound for a spell circle (1..8; some items pass 0). circle<9: play_random_tones(700, circle*1600+8000, 800); XOR-fill the 8x8 view cell at (0xb7,0xb7) with g_ui_color1; two play_sweep_noise calls from per-circle DATA.OVL tables (step 0x4b2c[c], threshold 0x4b08[c] rising then 0x4b1a[c] falling with negated step, count 10000+4000*c (Ghidra renders it as s_Missed_+1+c*4000), phase 0x4af6[c]); XOR-fill back. circle>=9: play_sweep_noise(1,300,65000,1,0x1180) only (scrolls/potions). Vector 1778:0986; called from CAST everywhere and from CAST2 e5ea/e6a2/e7c0/e99c/ead8.

name: pick_target_member
purpose: Prints 'On who: ' (0x94f4), calls select_party_member_no_zero; prints the member name (0x55a8+m*0x20) or 'None!' (0x94fe) when negative; newline if cursor column != 0. Returns the member index (negative = cancelled). Vector 1778:09aa.

name: read_spell_name
purpose: Spell-name entry by rune letters. Loop on read_command_key/to_upper: letters A..Z except J,O while <4 syllables: store letter, look up the syllable word at word table 0x1b7a[letter] (i.e. g_rune_syllable_ptrs 0x1bfc for 'A'), wrap line if column+len>13, record start column, print word + space. Backspace with >=1 syllable: cursor to (row or row-1 if column 0, start col), overwrite len spaces, cursor back, drop syllable. Enter/Space finish; Esc drops all and finishes; other keys ignored. Then bubble-sort the letters and compare, collapsing repeated letters, against the 48 alphabetised codes g_spell_code_ptrs[0..0x2f] (must end exactly). Returns index, -1 nothing typed, -2 no match (newline printed when anything was typed). Vector 1778:090e; callers CAST cast/use and CMDS mix.

0x1b7a.name: g_rune_syllable_ptrs_base
0x1b7a.meaning: word table indexed by ASCII letter; 'A' lands on g_rune_syllable_ptrs 0x1bfc

notes: Max 4 syllables (3 < n test). Collapsing: duplicate adjacent letters in the sorted input are skipped so a repeated rune still matches a single code letter.

name: ask_direction
purpose: Seeds g_dx/g_dy with the party x/y, or in combat (g_location>=0x80) with the active combatant's roster x/y; prints 'Direction-' (0x9504); loops on read_command_key: 1 West dx-1, 2 East dx+1, 3 North dy-1, 4 South dy+1 (prints the name, returns the code), Space prints 'Pass' and returns 0, other keys ignored. Vector 1778:0962.

name: heal_member

notes: random_damage_1_30 is given an unused argument in the C.

name: rel_hur_change_wind

notes: e63e (MOV AX,4 arm) and e648 (POP BP; RET) are its tail, split by Ghidra.

purpose: Kal Xen Corp. casting_flash(8 for spell, 5 for item). Up to 8 tries: COMBAT random_combat_cell, combat_cell_free(dy,dx,0xd8), map tile != 0xff; else return 0. add_combatant(z,dy,dx,0,0x26) (daemon); if index>=0: sweep noise, slot tile/anim=0x16, tile_transition_effect(dy,dx,0x1d8), slot tile/anim=0xd8; for the spell get_combat_stat(-1,active) (intelligence) must be > random_damage_1_30 else 'Oops...' (0x9532) and 0xffff; then roster flags |= 1 (ally) and return 1. 0 when no slot. Vector 1778:0992.

Else status 'G', hp=1; mp(+0xf)=int(+0xe) for class A/M, int/2 for B; if g_karma<98: exp(+0x14) = exp*karma/100 (32-bit); level(+0x16) = 1 + halvings of exp/100 to 0; max hp = level*30; casting_flash 8 (mode 0) or 6 (mode 1), none otherwise (BLCKTHRN passes 0xff); g_status_dirty=1; return 1. Vector 1778:0776; also SHOPPES b788 (healer).

Dungeon (g_location<0x80): optional casting_flash(4); cell g_dungeon_map[z][y][x] or, if not a field (hi nibble 8), the cell ahead by g_dungeon_facing (dy 0x24de[f], dx 0x24d6[f], & 7); field -> cell &= 8, 'Field destroyed!' name: shrine_quest_dialogue
purpose: Virtue shrine. Shrine index from g_shrine_x/y vs party x/y (6 if none). Party tile 0x6c (kneel), refresh, MISCMSG 0xb58b, wait, 0xb5b6 (virtue question), read_text_line(12, 0xbd08); empty -> leave. Answer must contain 0x4b3e[i] (4-letter virtue stem) and the mantra 0x1f5e[i] three times ('Mantra:' 0x958e, empty -> leave). Success: quest not done (g_shrine_quests_done bit clear) -> ordain (g_shrine_quests |= bit), texts 0xb5ff/0xb62c/quest 0xb21e+0x4b5e[i]/0x9598/0xb669, 7-note tune 0x4be6..0x4c1e; done but not ordained -> donation of N hundred gp (0xb692; 0 -> ' gp' leave; insufficient 0xb6b9), gold -= N*100, karma += N (cap 99), 'ALAKAZAM', sweeps 2000..25000 step 50; ordained and done -> clear bit, 0xb6d7, sweeps, earthquake_shake, karma+3 cap 99, +1 str(0x55b4)/dex/int capped 30 per 0x4b7e/0x4b86/0x4b8e flags, shrine 7 +3 karma more. Failure prints 0xb5de. Continues through ec1a.

0x4b5e.name: g_shrine_quest_text_off
0x4b5e.meaning: offset into MISCMSG buffer of the quest text

notes: Quest texts are printed as table value - 0x4de2, i.e. + 0xb21e.

Save g_location to 0xbd15, location 0xff, active combatant 0xff, back up the monster table (32x8 at 0x5c5a) to 0xa9fc clearing each tile; load MISCMAPS.DAT 0xb0 bytes at 0x160 (Codex) or 0xb0 (shrine) into g_view_objects and MISCMSG.DAT (0x3ab, 2000) into 0xb21e; copy 11 rows of 11 into g_light_map (stride 32); refresh; count records 1..15 with byte+0x1f==0x7f (urns) and place them; print 0xb8f9/0xb8cc; 4 steps; party figure slot 0 tile 0x1c at (5,10) z; step; Codex with urns: 'Thou dost see' + 'an urn marked:'/'urns marked:' + upper-cased names; walk up 7/4 rows; codex or virtue dialogue; figure back to 0x1c; walk down to row 10; clear slot 0; 4 steps; wait 10; restore monster table; restore location; pass_time(16); rebuild_light_map.
